policy.rankMeaning: research priority by authority and fit; NOT an empirically measured accuracy score

sourceDefinitions.priority1: official documents and dated primary match protocols for factual dispute resolution
sourceDefinitions.priority2: free structured historical result candidates; require record-level verification before use
sourceDefinitions.priority3: free API/current-event or secondary historical corroboration candidates with conditions
sourceDefinitions.priority4: supplementary, rights-limited or demonstrated-error reference only

sources.title: RFU official match calendar and protocols
sources.limitations: Official status does not grant automated bulk ingestion or redistribution.

sources.title: RPL competition documents and match protocols
sources.qualityEvidence: Primary-source formal match decisions; site footer reviewed 2026-10-20 (explicit ban on automated extraction). No licensed API, no empirically measured result error rate.
sources.limitations: The RPL official website expressly prohibits automated extraction of site information by any services without RPL's official permission; manual citation/checking of dated official results only. This primary-source authority is NOT an ingestion or ML license; no automatic browsing, scraping or headless browser harvesting.

sources.title: Dated official football club match reports
sources.limitations: An individual club report corroborates a match, not a complete licensed season or independent feed.

sources.title: OpenFootball Europe RPL TXT
sources.qualityEvidence: Five pinned source RPL seasons structurally parsed: 2018/19,2019/20,2020/21,2023/24,2024/25. Six awarded matches identified; 2023/24 wrong home venue. No independent match-level accuracy.
sources.limitations: Five discontinuous historical seasons, 2019/20 has four and 2020/21 two [awarded] technical scores; those administrative goals are NOT observed play. 2023/24 reverses one Sochi-Spartak home venue; no verified pre-match as-of history.

sources.title: Footbolno Russian football open data
sources.qualityEvidence: One-time 2026-10-20 publisher CSV SHA-256 dab9b30d... 2571 source rows/11 seasons: 2026/27 240 unique directed fixtures, 88 finished, 152 scheduled; 5 earlier seasons structurally anomalous. No official per-match accuracy measured.
sources.limitations: 2016/17-2020/21 source snapshots quarantined: incomplete, extra clubs, or duplicated fixtures (2020/21: 36 duplicate directed pairs). 2026/27 structurally complete at observed date ONLY; no recognized per-match published-at fields. The upstream license chain from ESPN/Wikipedia, awards, true score correctness and historical as-of remain unverified. No model training.

sources.title: SportScore public REST widgets
sources.limitations: Visible crawlable dofollow link on each data page; public endpoints may not cover full RPL history; quota and caching apply.

sources.title: API-Football Free
sources.limitations: Free 100 requests/day with historical limitations; no payment or paid fallback; require free account key held privately.

sources.title: RSSSF season tables
sources.limitations: Independence and update lag require verification; no authorized bulk import established.

sources.title: Championat RPL fixtures and season summaries
sources.limitations: Website visibility does not grant automated extraction or feed redistribution.

sources.title: Sportbox RPL season summaries
sources.limitations: No confirmed feed rights; potentially dependent on shared statistical upstream.

sources.title: Wikidata structured football facts
sources.limitations: Do not treat open-ended team membership as actual RPL registration or a match result.

sources.title: Wikipedia revision-pinned club and RPL articles
sources.limitations: No copying of complete article tables/media; match appearances are not full registered rosters.

sources.title: Rusfootball RPL results
sources.limitations: Documented 2026-04-26 Zenit–Akhmat 3-0 instead of official 2-0; no authoritative override.

sources.title: Football-Data.co.uk Russian CSV
sources.limitations: Private personal/academic research only; do not include in project automated ingestion or ML training.

sources.title: TheSportsDB free development API
sources.limitations: Free eventsseason endpoint 15 events; no approved full RPL production feed or free commercial launch.

sources.title: FootyStats public RPL catalog
sources.limitations: No scraping, crawling or copying site dataset; free RPL API entitlement not confirmed.

sources.title: Public GitHub mirror of historical Understat Russian league player aggregates
sources.limitations: Public CSV/Parquet do not grant redistribution or ML training. Player-season xG aggregates are NOT match-level as-of snapshots; repo lacks a license and source originates from Understat.

sources.title: Open Matchday public 2026-27 RPL football results directory
sources.qualityEvidence: Pinned 2026-10-20 open-matchday master 0e39da91... RPL CSV source reports 87 finished games and 242 goals; 109 scheduled: 44 fewer combined match/fixture rows than Footbolno's 240; source label soccerway only. No empirical match-level precision.
sources.limitations: Repository disclaimer restricts data to informational noncommercial use and leaves Soccerway upstream rights with publisher. RPL results 87/242 goals vs Footbolno 88/246 and 109 fixtures vs 152. Derived from same type of upstream editorial feed, not independently authenticated. No automated Soccerway scraping, provider importing, commercial reuse, ML training or source redistribution approved.

sources.title: SStats.net documented free football API
sources.qualityEvidence: 2026-10-20 manual terms/docs review only: public API docs state no-key requests capped at 30/min per IP and 300/min globally; some endpoints integrate Flashscore; no RPL fixture-accuracy or free historical entitlement check.
sources.limitations: Free HTTP access is not a license for storing, copying or training on upstream Flashscore/other provider data. Producer explicitly describes Flashscore integration and offers /Ls/* endpoints; identity of upstream rights holders, exact Russian Premier League 2024/25-2026/27 coverage, as-of publication times, ML and derivative public output permissions all unverified. No endpoint calls, stored rows, registration or adapter allowed in M0.
